ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 12:88 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity mottle clusters are mapped to the distal terminals and segments of the trailing edges; the central and proximal fluke areas consist of a solid, low-intensity contiguous field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated obtuse angle of approximately 145 degrees and a shallow pixel-depth relative to total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude jaggedness; the right lobe (viewer's right) contains three prominent, deep notches; the left lobe (viewer's left) exhibits lower-amplitude, high-frequency serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve profile; concave near the median notch transitioning to a convex arc along the outer margins toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular white pixel clusters concentrated on the extreme lateral distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two parallel, vertical linear tracks of higher intensity located on the lower-mid quadrant of the left lobe (viewer's left).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue void on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive white calcified accretions (barnacles) localized at the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, deep angular 'V' shaped notch located on the mid-trailing edge of the right lobe (viewer's right), distinct from standard serration patterns.
